name: Bolivia
description: Bolivia: High-altitude Arabica thrives in the Andes, producing complex, fruity, and floral coffees with bright acidity.

name: Brazil
description: Brazil: Dominant global producer, known for vast plantations and diverse varietals, primarily natural and pulped natural processing.

name: Burundi
description: Burundi: High-altitude, washed coffees, often with bright acidity and floral notes, from smallholder farms.

name: China
description: China: Emerging specialty coffee producer, focusing on Yunnan. Known for unique terroir and growing processing innovation.

name: Colombia
description: Colombia: Renowned for its diverse microclimates and innovative processing, producing consistently high-quality, balanced, and often fruity coffees.

name: Costa Rica
description: Costa Rica: Renowned for its vibrant, clean cups, often showcasing citrus and floral notes, with a strong commitment to quality and sustainability.

name: Democratic Republic Of The Congo
description: DRC: A nation with immense coffee potential, grappling with infrastructure and political instability, yet producing unique, often wild-grown, coffees with distinct flavor profiles.

name: Ecuador
description: Ecuador: Diverse microclimates yield unique, high-quality Arabica coffees, often with floral and citrus notes, especially from the Galapagos and Loja regions.

name: El Salvador
description: El Salvador: Renowned for its high-quality Bourbon and Pacamara varietals, often exhibiting bright acidity and sweet, fruity notes.

name: Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia: Birthplace of coffee, renowned for diverse heirloom varieties and complex, floral, and fruity flavor profiles, a cornerstone of global specialty coffee.

name: Guatemala
description: Guatemala: Volcanic soils and diverse microclimates yield complex, vibrant coffees, often with notes of chocolate and fruit.

name: Hawaii
description: Hawaii: Volcanic soils and unique microclimates yield exceptional, high-value Arabica coffees, primarily Kona.

name: Honduras
description: Honduras: A rising Central American star, known for its diverse microclimates yielding vibrant, often fruity, and complex specialty coffees.

name: India
description: India: Diverse microclimates yield robusta and arabica, often monsoon-processed, offering unique, bold, and spicy flavor profiles.

name: Indonesia
description: Indonesia: Archipelago of volcanic soils, producing diverse, bold, and often earthy coffees, renowned for rich body and unique processing methods.

name: Jamaica
description: Jamaica: Renowned for its Blue Mountain coffee, a highly sought-after, mild, and aromatic Arabica, grown at high altitudes.

name: Kenya
description: Kenya: Renowned for vibrant, complex coffees with bright acidity, often exhibiting blackcurrant and floral notes. A benchmark for quality.

name: Laos
description: Laos: Emerging specialty coffee producer in Southeast Asia, known for its Arabica and Robusta, often with floral and fruity notes.

name: Malaysia
description: Malaysia: Emerging specialty coffee scene, known for unique Robusta and experimental Arabica cultivation, often influenced by climate and innovative processing.

name: Mexico
description: Mexico: Diverse microclimates yield vibrant, complex coffees, often with chocolate and nutty notes, from Oaxaca to Chiapas.

name: Myanmar
description: Myanmar: Emerging specialty coffee, known for unique terroir and promising Arabica and Robusta varietals, gaining international recognition.

name: Nepal
description: Nepal: High-altitude Nepalese coffee offers delicate floral and citrus notes, a testament to its unique Himalayan terroir.

name: Nicaragua
description: Nicaragua: Rich volcanic soil yields diverse, high-quality beans, often with bright acidity and sweet, chocolatey notes.

name: Panama
description: Panama: Renowned for its high-altitude microclimates, producing exceptional Geisha and other varietals. Focus on quality, innovation, and sustainable practices.

name: Papua New Guinea
description: Papua New Guinea: Known for its wild, often Bourbon and Typica varietals, offering complex, fruity, and floral notes, highly sought after in specialty markets.

name: Peru
description: Peru: A rising star in specialty coffee, known for its diverse microclimates yielding vibrant, complex, and often organic beans.

name: Philippines
description: Philippines: Emerging specialty producer with unique Arabica and Robusta varietals, known for its distinct terroir and growing focus on quality.

name: Rwanda
description: Rwanda: Emerging East African powerhouse, known for vibrant acidity, floral notes, and increasing focus on washed processing and direct trade.

name: South Africa
description: South Africa: Emerging specialty producer, known for unique varietals and innovative processing, gaining global recognition for quality.

name: Sudan
description: Sudan's specialty potential is largely untapped, with a rich history of coffee cultivation and unique varietals awaiting discovery and development.

name: Sumatra
description: Sumatra: Earthy, bold, and complex. Known for its unique wet-hulling process, offering a distinctive profile prized in specialty coffee.

name: Taiwan
description: Taiwan: Emerging specialty producer, known for high-quality, often floral and fruity, single-origin Taiwanese coffees.

name: Tanzania
description: Tanzania: Known for its vibrant, complex coffees, particularly from Kilimanjaro and the Southern Highlands, offering bright acidity and fruity notes.

name: Thailand
description: Thailand offers unique, high-altitude Arabicas and robustas, increasingly recognized for quality and distinct flavor profiles in the specialty market.

name: Timor Leste
description: Timor-Leste: Emerging specialty producer with unique Arabica varieties, often exhibiting bright acidity and complex floral/fruity notes. Growing recognition in the specialty market.

name: Uganda
description: Uganda: Emerging specialty producer, known for robust, fruity coffees, particularly from the Rwenzori Mountains and Bugisu regions. Growing in quality and recognition.

name: Venezuela
description: Venezuela: Once a specialty powerhouse, now facing challenges, but its unique high-altitude beans hold immense potential for revival.

name: Vietnam
description: Vietnam: A powerhouse in Robusta production, increasingly exploring specialty Arabica, offering unique flavor profiles and sustainable practices.

name: Yemen
description: Yemen: Ancient birthplace of coffee cultivation, renowned for its unique, wild, and heirloom varietals, often processed naturally, yielding complex, wine-like, and fruity profiles.

name: Zambia
description: Zambia: Emerging specialty coffee, known for bright acidity and complex fruit notes, particularly from the high-altitude regions.
